exercises.question: Choose the sentence that uses the most natural and correct word combination (collocation).
options: I need to do a quick phone call before the strategy session begins.
We made a lot of progress on the software migration this week.
The guest speaker did an inspiring speech at the annual conference.
She took a new business with her international partners.
exercises.feedbackCorrect: Excellent! In English, we always "make progress," never "do progress."
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: Look closely at the verbs paired with the nouns. We make a phone call (not do), we give or deliver a speech (not do), and we start or set up a business (not take).

exercises.question: The manager asked everyone to ________ attention to the safety rules.
exercises.explanation: The fixed collocation is 'pay attention to.'
